messages.text: She called me before breakfast asking what day you were coming, then asked again while she was putting on her sneakers.
Mom's hall closet still has a box with your 2019 HSS folder in it. Toss or keep?
I moved the Saturday drive to the 14th and set the prepared dinners to start Thursday. Hempstead address is confirmed.
Keep the folder, please. It has the right-knee PT sheets from after that baseball slide mess.
Good. She still did her full mile yesterday, so at least that part is steady.
Also found a stapled med page with your notes: '4 days, then Tylenol.' Want that too?
I’ll check the front-step clips after work and see whether the installer fixed the late-night motion pings.
Yes, put it with the folder. I like having the exact dates when doctors ask.
Tom says Saturday works if you and Linda can get here by 5:30. I will put the Garden City parking pass on the porch.
That works. I also owe Sarah a reply about whether lunch near Madison Square Park is better before or after her 1:00 client review.
Before, definitely. She has two brand boards to present and will be useless afterward.
Then I will text her for 11:45 and bring the Vanguard printout she asked about.
Mom forwarded me another 'Chase locked your account' thing. Can you look before she taps anything?
Yes. Tell her not to touch the blue button. I am saving that one for Saturday's examples too.
Also Mrs. Ito said her iPad screen goes black when she tries to call her grandson.
I'll stop by Hempstead after work Thursday, then check Mrs. Ito and Mr. Bell on the way home.
Can I still do the $600 transfer date as the 5th? Columbia portal is being dramatic again.
Yes. I just closed February in the spreadsheet at 9,500, so I want March kept tighter, but your line is already in there.
Was February the Otis thing plus Mom's brake appointment?
Exactly. Those two were the outliers; the house payment and the usual cards are already set to clear in full.
Emily is trying to line up everyone for Sunday. She already asked about seating, dessert, and whether the piano bench still wobbles.
Tell her the bench is fixed. Daniel said he may be late if the payments launch meeting runs over.
Mara texted me too. They can bring salad if they get out of Park Slope before traffic gets silly.
Good. I will start the lamb early and let Emily boss the table order once she gets here from uptown.
I found the folder with the June 1996 paperwork in the dining room cabinet. The scan is good enough for the cabin form.
Good. I can upload that with the Athens quote tonight if the site stops timing out.
Also please do not pick the boat with the tiny shower. After two Naples runs in 2023, I have earned decent plumbing.
Fair. I will compare the Naxos route and the Paros route after I call your mother tomorrow.
Your Tuesday call window still good? I found that shot of you on the striped path above Manarola while clearing my Dropbox.
Still good. Send it over. Linda wants old coastal photos before we start comparing those furnished places outside Lucca.
Lucca for that long sounds like you two are finally taking the slow route.
Only sketching. I need to see how 60-90 days would work with bills, Otis, and Mom before it becomes real.
Forgot to ask on the drive: did the second guy ever send the number for the cabinets and counters?
Sent you the clip from last night's postgame thread. Did it open or are you still refusing to put that app back on the phone?
He did. Higher than the first one, somehow. I stuck both PDFs in the house folder and closed the tab before I said something dramatic.
Still phone-free since November. If it needs a login, I'll see it from the laptop some other time.
Fair. I did notice you managed to like my dry-fly photo from Saturday, so you're not completely off the grid.
Classic. Same folder as those Rhinebeck listings you were pretending Linda found by accident?
That one I browse from the couch. Mostly just tapping hearts and looking at dinner plates.
Those are just rainy-night browsing. Emily still has half a closet here and a tuition bill with our name on it.
Found Uncle Ray's old Nassau County dress cap in Mom's cedar closet. Do you want it, or should I keep it with the photos?
Mom's old box has Dad's baptism card, your confirmation booklet, and those brittle family-tree pages with Yorkshire on one side and Antrim on the other.
Keep it with the photos for now. Dad always made us stand up straighter when Ray came by in that thing.
Keep the tree pages. I want to compare them with the Hempstead cemetery notes before they disappear into somebody's attic.
True. Also going through the forms for Mom's file and nothing strange came up for any of us or the cousins.
Also found the children's certificates from that tiny font at the old parish hall. Linda's handwriting is on both envelopes.
Good. That matches what I remember. Our side was boring on paper, thankfully.
That tracks. We were still doing the family milestones then, even if the Sunday habit had already thinned out for us.
Clinic board packet for Thursday has that ER-diversion pilot again. You still think dispatch should send a trained civilian pair on the nonviolent calls?
Yes. Keep uniforms for danger, but the 2am hallway breakdown should not start with cuffs and a cruiser.
Same packet has the insulin margin chart. Ugly.
Twenty years seeing the billing side made me less romantic. Give people another card to choose, then squeeze the drug and hospital numbers hard.
Still good for the commute call? I have Bronx clinic board notes and the Yankees rotation to complain about.
Yes. Send the clinic packet first. I want accountability language in there, just not a budget number someone made up at midnight.
That sounds like you. Also, I found your Obama '08 photo from Catskills weekend. You had the same jacket in the 2012 one.
That jacket did more canvassing-adjacent coffee runs than actual canvassing. Call me when you get on Northern.
Mara's firm just froze two analyst openings because the new workflow tool is doing first-pass review. Not great timing for people trying to get their first rung.
That is exactly why I pushed back on cutting our junior shadow days this morning. Once the first rung disappears, it is hard to rebuild.
Dad, Mara found one more 1098 from her co-op lender. Do you and Mom still keep all that stuff in the same blue folder?
Makes sense. Also did your company portal accept the LDF receipt this time or did it kick it back again?
Blue folder for the house papers, yellow for donations and medical. Your mother gets the final stack before I touch the March payments.
Accepted after I renamed the PDF. Queens youth center one is still pending, probably because their confirmation came as an email.
Makes sense. Tell her I said good luck with the Gatsby pile too.
She has three sections left and a Nakamura list on top of it. Kitchen table is officially closed for dinner.
I can be home by 7:45 if you want to keep tonight's couch plan.
Works. I left The Pelican Brief on the table from the library stack.
Good. Make popcorn before I get in, not after the opening credits.
Already put the pot out. I'll walk Otis first.
Tom says the Garden City place down the block just posted at 1.18. Are Little Neck listings still that wild?
Pretty much. The last two near us were right around 1.1, which still feels absurd when I remember our 2001 folder.
Mom would faint at those numbers. Keep that old folder if you're comparing anything.
I did. It has the 385K sheet and the Queens assessment notices all in one envelope.
Dad, for your portal note, use the CDC adult schedule table instead of that thread Daniel sent. Cleaner.
Already saved it. Patel's office wants the October CVS date and the card photo, so I am adding those before I ask about the newer one.
Also Katelyn Jetelina covered the age cutoff last week. I'll forward it after seminar.
Perfect. I want the actual table and Patel's answer, not three people arguing in replies.
Are we doing tomorrow at your place or Daniel's? I can bring that Columbia bakery rye if Linda hasn't planned bread.
Our place. Lamb shoulder already salted. Linda asked me to remind everyone the hallway bowl is back in service.
Fine, but tell Daniel I am not letting him filibuster congestion pricing before salad again.
Noted. Also checking whether the Garcias want the 21st instead of this Friday.
You already passed Mom's block? I saw your car by Springfield when I was driving back.
Did the Alley Pond path first, then cut over. Muddy near the wooden bridge but worth it.
Of course you picked the cold morning. You sounded calmer when you called after.
That hour before everyone is up does more for me than another room full of folding chairs.
Tom is making sauce tonight. Want me to bring the Chianti we opened yesterday?
Save it for your house. If you come by Mom's first, bring one Sangiovese instead. I am counting today as glass 2 for the week.
Fine, professor. And I told Jake he can keep the little porch routine at his own apartment, not Mom's driveway.
Good. I will stand inside with the leftovers and the corkscrew.
Tom asked if you ever get tired of being the database referee at work. I said you seem to like sorting the messy ones.
Today was SQL Server vs Postgres vs Mongo again, plus a Cassandra wrinkle. I like the puzzle more than the meetings.
And after you hit 63, you'll still be taking those calls, just from our porch with coffee.
Only if they're short calls. By 64 I want the calendar to have more guest talks and fewer escalation threads.
Mara says the hallway smells unfairly good already. Are you doing the covered pot thing again?
Six hours if I don't get impatient. Rosemary, sumac, onions, then leave it alone.
You always say leave it alone and then hover over it.
That's the part I never learned properly. The turning part, yes. The waiting part, no.
If Daniel and Mara come early, can you pick up the usual dozen from the corner on Little Neck Pkwy before they sell out?
Yes. I will go before 8. Also still thinking Northern Blvd for dinner unless you want to cook.
Northern Blvd is easier. Emily asked if the place with the stone bowls has parking again.
Cho Dang Gol has the side lot if we get there before 6.
Before Sunday dinner, can you check whether Emily's $600 cleared? She said the portal nags her if the draft account is short.
It cleared Friday morning. I left it under her usual memo so she can match it.
Good. Also don't bring up the old Columbia folder unless she does. She looked steady last night and I don't want to turn a good visit into a review session.
Agreed. I'll just put it in the hallway box and let her decide.
You already at your desk? Mara says nobody should be answering Slack this early.
Coffee, Otis around the block, then inbox. Linda was still grading when I came back in.
Tell her I said the Gatsby essays can wait until sunrise.
Mara has two spare folding chairs if you still do that June thing on the street.
Yes, bring them Sunday if it is not a pain. I am also sending you home with basil starts unless you object.
I will take basil. Please label it better than last year, I planted one of Mr. Chen's peppers in the wrong pot.
Fair. I have blue tape on his tray this time.
Do you still want me to print the portal stuff before Sunday dinner?
Mara asked why you had twenty name tags in your coat pocket yesterday.
Yes, just the two sets: the late-2024 one with the 10-year callback line, and the two Feb-2025 pages from the morning at North Shore.
Leftovers from Thursday. I forgot to put them back with the pizza receipts and HDMI adapters.
Got it. The one after that awful game night, plus the one from the day you lived on broth.
Very on brand. Also, my analyst wants to know if your Frank Russo story is the one with the broken Oracle export.
Exactly. No need to make a production of it at dinner.
Same story. I can tell the short version Wednesday before I look at Priya's indexing notes and clean up the NYU SPS examples.
I moved my Garden City portal login out of the junk drawer. Yours is still clipped to the NYU folder.
I pulled the February folder. Mine shows a little under $7,500 before deductions, yours shows the usual $16,500-ish for the month.
Good. Patel's office wants the March numbers uploaded before Friday.
That matches what I have. After all the withholding and deferrals, my bank side was just over $9,200.
Then do it tonight, please. And take the little white one before you start grading bills at the kitchen table.
Good. I will use those with my 403(b) page and your 401(k) page when I finish the organizer.
Leave the March-only line blank for now until the extra deposit actually posts.
Done. I also put the 198 from last visit into the same note so I can stop pretending I forgot it.
You still on for the Tuesday call tomorrow, or did the 8 pm release window swallow you?
Still on. No extra pay for sitting through that window, so I am taking Friday morning back if it runs late.
Good. Also, bring the latest EOB numbers. If you already crossed that first $1,500 line in March, I want to hear how.
We are close. Linda's imaging, my labs, and the specialist copays did most of it.
Saw your missed call. I was still at the Manhasset office. Everything okay?
Yeah. Just one of those things I wanted to run past you before I brought it to Linda.
Call me after 8:30 if you want. I have the Bronx packet open anyway, so I will be up.
Thanks. Also remind me Tuesday to check the wader patch kit before we pick dates.
You still doing that noon loop by the water or did March weather kill it?
Kept it today. Phone says 2,900 steps before my 1 pm call, which is more useful than sitting with a sandwich.
Good. Also Forest Park posted the April 3.1 course map. Mara may do it if you two are signing up.
Send it. I like those little neighborhood bib mornings more than staring at machines in a basement.
Dad, Mara's aunt got one of those delivery-fee texts. Do you still have the handout with the red circles?
I do. Linda cleaned up the screenshots after Saturday, so they are clearer now.
Can you send it? Also Grandma asked if the camera icon is the same one Mrs. Ito uses.
Sending both pages. Tell Grandma the green button starts it, but I will walk her through it Thursday.
Can I send you the intake testimony from my seminar? It is very much a Sunday dinner argument starter.
Send it. If families show up at a clinic desk, we handle them like neighbors. Just attach the funding page too.
Of course you want the spreadsheet before the moral victory.
The moral victory has to survive Albany math. Also remind me when the June card lands; November is already blocked.
Calling at 6:20 instead of 6:00. I need five minutes to yell at the YES app first.
Still doing your Tuesday detour by the water before our call?
Fine by me. Judge is up second, so I will be yelling too.
Only if traffic lets me. Clouds over Little Neck Bay look worth the extra ten minutes.
How did your Saturday group look? Still the same eight at Alley Pond after?
You and those heavy shadow shots. Send one after you get home.
Same table, same bad knees. We kept it to gloves, kids, and the Bronx score once Eddie started on city hall.
If the highlights hold. I borrowed that old Yosemite book from the library again for ideas.
Usual Tuesday car call, or are you still at the desk?
Leaving Midtown now. Susan Park kept the 4:30 review tight, so I should be on Northern Blvd in twenty.
Good. I have Yankees complaints and clinic-board irritation, in that order.
Perfect. Tomorrow is the wall-to-wall room day, so tonight I can actually listen.
Still okay for the drive call tonight, or did the 45th St crew swallow your evening?
I can talk. Just left after settling Rina and Pat on the vendor bridge and giving Jamal's group the runbook changes.
That's the cloud-side thing that keeps waking you up, right?
This is my loud week, so phone stays on. If it buzzes, I'll call you back after I clear the alert.
Carol left the blue folder in your car after Garden City. Do you need it before you see Sarah tomorrow?
Yes, that has the sample budget pages. Sarah asked for the version that separates quarterly taxes from rent.
I put it by your briefcase. Also, Carol said Tom found your glasses under their dining table.
Of course he did. I will pick them up when we are out there again.
You still taking that once-a-month Thursday pass from home next week?
Probably. Depends whether I can get out of the 5:30 call cleanly.
If you end up downtown, send me whatever Kamasi track they open with. I need something for the ride back from Manhasset.
Deal. If it is Queens instead, I will send a photo of the tiny stage and your cardiologist eyes can judge the chair setup.
Mara and I looked at a Park Slope open house. The monthly math is brutal even before common charges.
Run the full monthly number, not just the listing. Our automatic draft is 3,200 before the escrow swing gets folded in.
Was yours always that tidy or did you redo it?
Redid it when everyone was locked down. Fifteen-year paper at 2.875; the payoff row now lands about seven years out.
Can you send Emily the recipe timing? She is making a spreadsheet for the 22nd and I am apparently on bread duty.
Of course. How was the demo?
Survived. I ran eight miles after because the fraud-flow edge cases kept looping in my head.
That sounds like you. I will send her the timing, and you and Mara can bring bread from the place on 7th Ave.
Mom said you two are looking at a boat that starts in Piraeus. Are you still doing the June thing or pushing it later?
Likely later. Her school calendar, your grandmother's December rhythm, and hurricane fares all make June messy.
Send me the photo from the old album if you use it on the little card. Mom's hair in 1996 deserves its own exhibit.
I will. And if we land on the Santorini stop, I am blaming you for making us watch those ferry videos.
You sounded distracted on the drive. Everything okay, or did the Yankees bullpen already ruin March?
Just moving numbers around. February came in a thousand over where I like it, and I hate seeing the cushion shrink.
Temporary hit or a pattern?
Temporary. Otis and Linda's car both picked the same week. The title-folder rule still saves us from adding another monthly line.
Clinic board packet is grim. Two county forms changed again and the volunteer coordinator says nobody can tell her which office owns the next step.
That kind of slow breaking worries me more than the headline fights. Same with election offices being treated like disposable back rooms.
You still putting that Queens group through your employer match? Send me the name again; one of our residents asked where local kids can get Saturday help.
Yes, same Little Neck/Flushing youth center. I will forward the receipt and their spring tutoring flyer after I finish the budget memo for the junior rotations.
Mom found an old CVS bag in the den closet with Emily's name on it. Do you want me to toss it when I stop by Hempstead?
Please don't toss yet. If it's from her second year, Linda wants Emily to make that call.
Understood. Separate thing: was the $600 for her place already handled? I won't mention it Sunday if it is.
Handled. Chase shows posted, and she has the receipt screenshot.
Can I steal your Terraform module naming pattern? We keep making one-off infra folders and it's getting ugly.
Use provider-env-purpose, then keep Ansible inventory separate. I can send the Azure SQL and RDS examples after my practice questions.
Practice questions as in the cloud thing with all the Glue/Kinesis/Redshift sections?
That one. After it, I'm saving the Google-heavy prep for summer. Python cleanup tonight first.
Running late for the call. Northern Blvd is crawling again.
No rush. I got waved through near Douglaston after the taillight lecture, so I am home earlier than expected.
That is still only your second roadside lecture since college, right?
Second in 35 years behind the wheel. Both ended with a reminder and no paperwork, so I am not complaining.
You free after work Tuesday, or are you making the Northern Blvd detour again?
Tuesday is tight. I can talk from the car after Little Neck, before I turn toward Cho Dang Gol.
Fine by me. If you pass the Parkway corner in the morning, get me two poppy for the office and I will owe you.
Text me before 7:30 or I will forget.
On Tuesday remind me to send the NEJM link. It has the cleaner chart for the fall formulation timing.
Thanks. Patel's nurse confirmed my October entry is in their system, but I still want to understand the interval.
Good. Bring your CVS dates and skip the Facebook screenshots. Half those posts mash up last year's guidance.
That is why I ask you and Patel before I do anything new.
Tom found the big serving trays from Mom's garage. Do you want them for June or are you covered?
Take two if you can spare them. The long table gets crowded once the grill tools and salads land.
Done. Also Mom asked why there were little tomato cups on your passenger floor last weekend.
Those were for Mr. Chen. I forgot to drop them before Hempstead.
Tom asked how you two keep the emergency money separate from the market stuff. He keeps mixing ours together.
We keep the cushion at Marcus, the long-term taxable bucket at Vanguard, and I do not touch the HSA except to invest it.
That is cleaner than our spreadsheet. Is Linda using the school plan too?
Yes, hers is through the district, plus we each still fund our own IRA when the cash flow timing works.
I found the metal skewers in Mom's basement drawer, wrapped in that 2014 Newsday.
Keep them for me. If they're the long flat ones, those were the good ones.
Also a stained index card that says not to crowd the chops.
That card still outranks every recipe site on the internet.
Mara says the restaurant near us has a Friulian wine dinner. Want me to grab two seats for you and Mom?
Maybe. Your mother is using the old Napa binder to make me admit I still like a tasting room when it is not crowded.
That binder is older than my job. Also, are you actually looking at staying put somewhere over there for a whole season?
Very early math. If we can keep it under the 90-day limit, one base and a lot of trains looks better than hopping every few nights.
You alive after the morning circus?
Barely. Took a one-hopper off the shin guarding the line, then Sal bought egg sandwiches for all eight of us.
That spot has been trying to maim you since I was ten.
Worth it. Shower, ice pack, then I am planting myself for Brunson at the Garden tonight.
Can I swing by tomorrow and steal the old blue Columbia hoodie from my room?
Sure. Linda and I are here after errands. Otis may camp outside your door if he hears you.
Good. I owe him a belated 7th-birthday biscuit anyway.
Bring it early if you want the full tail-wag inspection before my 6:30 call.
Mom said your annual is Monday. Are you bringing the packet or trusting the portal gods?
Packet. I put the 'see you in 10' note behind the treadmill graph and dye-machine summary.
Very you. Please also bring the actual Mets ticket stub if you kept it, because that story keeps changing.
Yankees, not Mets. And the stub stays in the desk.
I may come home the 27th if that is okay. Please do not let anyone turn my room into a sample-tile warehouse.
Your room is safe. The tile stack is still in the dining room, where it can judge me properly.
Dad, I tagged you in the birthday brunch pictures and you still have the empty gray circle as your picture.
Also Mom sent me a listing in Guilford with a porch and then immediately wrote 'do not read into this.'
I saw the tag. That account is mostly for keeping up with you and Daniel, not curating a museum of me.
Accurate caption. We are looking the way people look at boats online, and meanwhile I am not signing a $70k cabinet-and-wall adventure.
At least add the lemon pasta one from Italy. Your last square is still the harbor shot from December.
Quarterly pace seems dignified. I'll add the pasta tonight if the tablet remembers me.
You still taking the Queens trails before breakfast or did the knees finally win?
Knees negotiated. I kept it to the Alley Pond side path and the hill by the tennis courts.
Good. You always sound less clenched after those sunrise miles.
It is the one place I can let the noise settle before the day starts.
Rain line is moving in before midnight. Your old weather station acting up yet?
Right side started barking during the third inning. Same spot from 2019.
The baseball gods keep receipts. Still just Tylenol when it grumbles?
Yes. The stronger stuff was only those first few days back then.
Tom and I are taking Mom to Hempstead Lake around 11. Paths should be dry by then.
I might meet you after breakfast. The bare branches over the water were good last March.
Bring the small bag, not the giant one. Mom will ask why you need all that equipment.
Small bag. One lens, yellow filter, and the trail map.
Mara and I can make 6 today, but I have to leave by 8:15. Big Monday launch.
That works. Linda is moving the little tray near the front door so nobody keeps checking work pings at the table.
Good. Emily owes me five uninterrupted minutes on the Queens DA thing after dessert.
Earn them by not baiting her during soup. Also I owe Mark Garcia a headcount for Friday.
Mara asked if your Dec 24 candle thing is still mostly the choir and brass.
Exactly. We go when the music list is good. No one is checking attendance cards.
Fine by me. I can sit through carols if nobody expects me to do the parts in bold.
Deal. You can stand, sit, and hum selectively like the rest of us.
For dinner, can we avoid Dad-vs-Daniel round 6? I am bringing Mara and I want one normal lamb shoulder.
No promises, but I will keep it to two topics: why the hospital list price is fiction, and why the intake desk still needs names and dates.
That is already three topics if Daniel hears the word desk.
Then I will say it softer. People can be welcomed and still counted correctly.
I am coming up for dinner. Do you want me to grab anything near Columbia before the train?
If the shop has a decent Sangiovese, yes. Lamb shoulder is in, and I am leaving room for one pour.
One pour entered into the family spreadsheet. Also Mara offered her tin for after dessert; I said you never take those.
Correct answer. Just bring yourself and maybe that bottle.
Before I do taxes: your W-2, ESPP statement, HSA form, and the tuition reimbursement email are all in the blue folder?
Yes. I also printed the learning-account receipt for the security course, $1,500 exactly.
Perfect. Mine has the school deductions again, yours has the stock purchase line. I will keep the piles separate.
Thanks. I added the March EOBs too, in case the medical folder needs them.
Can you call Mom after your morning thing? The meal service left the cooler by the side door again.
Yes. I have the 9:30 Teams block from the den, then I can call Hempstead before Susan Park's 10:15.
Thanks. Also ask her if the doorbell battery is chirping; she mentioned a beep yesterday.
Will do. Easier today since I'm not catching the LIRR before sunrise.
Leaving clinic board early. If you hit the Clearview by 6:15, I can do our drive-time slot.
Perfect. I have twenty-five minutes before I walk in the house.
Good. We can do Yankees first, then the Linda question if you still want a dry run.
Dry run first, then Yankees. And bring the 5-weight in May if Beaverkill is high.
Saw your missed call. Everything okay after the Hempstead run?
Mostly. I added weekday lunches through the service and wrote the heating steps in marker on the lids.
That sounds like you. Did she get out for her walk?
Yes, same mile loop. She did ask three times whether Linda was teaching today, so I’m going to price the 10-to-2 help Carol mentioned.
Are you and Mom using the den tomorrow or can I leave my keyboard case there when I come up?
Leave it there. We are downstairs tomorrow with Julie & Julia after dinner.
That sounds very you two. I'll put my bag in my old room then.
Perfect. Text before you get on the train.
I packed your gray towel. We need to leave by 6:35 if we want the two bikes near the fan.
Thanks. I am doing the extra lap outside after lunch too, so tonight may be a slower gear night.
Slow gear is fine. Just show up. We can grab the new Bayside 3.1 sign-up sheet at the desk after.
Deal. I will skip the heavy row of machines and save my legs for that.
How did Patel take the spreadsheet?
He laughed at the color coding, then circled the late dinners and the missed Thursday tablet.
Classic you. Same guy still using the yellow pad from twelve years ago?
Yes. He wrote 5'10 and 198 on it like I was being booked, then underlined 183.
Are you and Linda around the week after Palm Sunday, or is that when you are pricing the charter deposit?
Around. Deposit call is Friday. We are keeping April clear in case her mom needs one of us down there after the checkup.
Got it. I still remember you two leaving for Queens after that June '96 reception and pretending you were calm.
I remember you handing me an envelope and telling me not to lose the hotel key.
Can you look at my rollout checklist after dinner Sunday? Trying to keep the blast radius sane.
Send it. I spent nine years learning which boxes to double-check before anyone touches production, so I have opinions.
Fair. Are your seven all on the same page now?
Mostly. Two can run the room without me; the other five need tighter steps before the next Azure batch.
Can Sunday start at 5 instead of 4:30? My Columbia group is meeting near 168th to clean up the neighborhood-clinic data.
5 works. Daniel said he has a 10K route planned before they come in from Brooklyn anyway.
Perfect. Also please do not let him bring six backup options for salad again.
No promises. Send me the updated headcount and I will keep the piano room clear if you are staying over.
Mom asked me to scan the donation receipt from Columbia's drive. Does she want it in yellow or blue?
Yellow. Blue is house and bank. She has the Nakamura worksheet open tonight after the Bayside parent night.
Of course she stacked parent night, essays, and that spreadsheet on one Thursday.
I am doing ConEd and AmEx before she gets home, so at least the table won't have my pile on it.
I moved dinner earlier so you can catch the 8:00 thing near Columbus Circle.
Thank you. I will take the 7 if I miss the E.
Bring the warmer coat. Last time you came home from Manhattan talking about Wynton for twenty minutes and shivering.
I printed 18 copies for April. The Little Neck group wanted the bigger arrows on the fake bank page.
Good. I will add the package text too; Mom and Mr. Bell both fell for that wording at first.
And the video-calling page needs fewer steps. Mrs. Ito got lost after contacts.
I'll make it six steps max before we go back next month.
I left the Bayside Honda receipt on your desk. They split pads and rotors clearly this time.
Got it. I put it under the auto tab and the March running total is back behaving, even with gas and insurance.
Good. Do you need anything from the Civic folder too?
No, both folders are complete. Titles, insurance cards, inspection slips. Nice not having a bank statement for either one.
Dad, the Columbia library scanner made your handouts crooked but readable. Want me to redo the packet?
Readable is fine. I only need the normalization exercise and the hospital feed example for the SPS room.
Got it. Also I found your sticky note: "ask Frank what he would cut." Very dramatic for table diagrams.
That note saves me every time. After Tuesday I'll send the same trimmed version to Ravi for the April Thursday crowd.
Tom wants to know if you are still coming to the Garden City breakfast thing. The speaker list looks spicy.
I am. I want to hear the DA candidate explain body-cam discipline without the bumper-sticker nonsense.
And the county clerk panel?
That too. If the system cannot say who came through which door on which date, it is asking for backlash.
Tom says if you want his cabinet guy's name, he can ask. Though if your two quotes already made you make that face, maybe don't.
The face was earned. We are keeping the old layout through this year and pretending the backsplash has character.
Linda told me you two were clicking around Litchfield after dinner. Are you abandoning Queens without telling your sister?
No announcement. Just talking in hypotheticals for when Emily is really off our spreadsheet and not using the Little Neck room between Columbia deadlines.
Mom asked why there is a framed picture of you and Linda in front of red gates in the den. She remembers the frame, not where it was.
